title: A Van Full of Fresh Food
transcript: A mobile food shop will start visiting four villages where the nearest supermarket is more than ten kilometres away. The van will carry bread, milk, vegetables and a small selection of other everyday goods. It will stop for forty minutes in each village on Tuesday afternoons. Customers can pay by cash or card, and they can ask the driver to bring particular items the following week. A village council will share the timetable on local noticeboards.

questions.prompt: Why were the four villages chosen?
options: Their farms produce too much food.
Their bus routes are under repair.
Their shops all close on weekends.
Their nearest supermarkets are far away.
questions.answer: Their nearest supermarkets are far away.
questions.explanation: 选择这些村庄是因为最近的超市距离超过十公里。

questions.prompt: What can customers ask the driver to do?
options: Bring certain goods on the next visit.
questions.answer: Bring certain goods on the next visit.
questions.explanation: 顾客可以要求司机下一周带来指定商品。
